title: Barely changed since 1975, this Illinois home found a buyer
summary_full: Listed at $259,900, a charming 1975 East Dubuque house attracted immediate interest, with potential buyers contacting the listing agent just three days after its debut. The vibrant colors and thick shag carpeting were highlights that drew attention. The new owner is excited to modernize certain fixtures while honoring the home's distinct character.
